name: Pyramid · 9 Waves
_design: Journey of the Mummy Pyramid zone (level-designer 2026-11-17, rebuilt by the combat-designer 2026-11-17 for the full mummy family). Same schema as goblin_waves.json (wave_mode: ONE fight of 9 waves on one 16x9 board picked from arena_maps by seed, the boss is wave 9, wave_heal_fraction is the rest between waves). Boss 2026-11-17: the mummies live ONLY here, no goblin in this file and no mummy in goblin_waves (tests/test_journey_families.gd derives the families from the data). MONSTER MIX: the goblin journey's 9 waves one to one with each goblin swapped for its mummy twin (goblin -> mummy, goblin_archer -> mummy_archer, goblin_knight -> mummy_knight, goblin_mage -> mummy_mage, goblin_chief -> mummy_boss, the Mummy Pharaoh), same counts and levels, except the debut order (PO 2026-11-17: grunts, archers, knights, mages): w1 mummies, w2 the archer, w3 the knight, w4 the mage (the goblin's w3/w4 swapped), w5-w8 mixes, w9 the BOSS PAIR (Boss 2026-11-17): the Mummy High Wizard (mummy_high_wizard, the big 3.4 m pharaoh-mage) and the Mummy Pharaoh (mummy_boss, the 'mini pharaoh'), both boss: true, with 2 mummies (x1.5 = 3) that rise from summoning circles as the pair arrives (client/monster_vfx.gd). The level-2 archer + mage escorts were dropped (combat-designer 2026-11-18, see _tuning_boss_pair): in wave mode every monster of a stage arrives together (the stage 'waves'/'wave' fields only work on the old road), so they did not 'rise when hurt' anyway, and the pair alone keeps the bosses the threat. The mummy family is the goblin family x1.5 on HP/ATK/DEF (Boss 2026-10-21 ratio, the zone step), so the difficulty is set by stage power and wave_power_by_squad, see _tuning. Camp/treasure/challenge fields are kept for schema parity (the 12-stage road mode is off; logic/journey_data.gd still requires boss_map, so it names an arena board; there is no camp map since the throne/rest maps were removed 2026-11-18).
blurb: ด่านเดียว 9 เวฟ ปิดท้ายด้วยจอมเวทฟาโรห์และฟาโรห์มัมมี่
_tuning: PLACEHOLDER until the Boss plays (level-designer 2026-11-17, tools/balance/class_sim.gd journey=mummy_waves only=starter:squad, 60 seeds = 4 x 15, starter squad lv1 starter gear, wave_power_by_squad unchanged from goblin_waves): boss power 1.15 -> 55%, 1.09 -> 81% (chosen, target ~82%), 1.05 -> 93%, 0.95 -> 98%. Damage taken per wave 1..9 at 1.09: 46 56 139 106 175 188 183 227 611; every loss comes at the boss. Solo/duo not measured.
_tuning_ranged_stamina: combat-designer 2026-11-20 (Boss: the magic squad is too strong, ~99%; ranged classes spam attacks because their stamina was the cheapest; increase their stamina use; the goblin zone also loses its between-wave heal). Measured with tools/balance/class_sim.gd (level 15, tier-1 gear; new measurement-only overrides wstamx:/sstam:/sstat:/wpow:/race:, and a stamina table: refused moves per run, share of alive time below the light_1 cost, share with a skill off cooldown but short of stamina). BEFORE (60 seeds, power 1.36): starter squad 56.7%, magic squad 98.3%, 3x each class 0%; longbow starved 1.2% of alive time, magic 0%. STAMINA ONLY (longbow x1.5, magic x1.6, class skills +35%): starter 36.7%, magic squad still 98.3% (magic starved 10% / skill-short 16%, longbow 19% / 21%); halving magic skill damage, 1.5x cooldowns or removing its crowd control left it at 94-100%. The real reason was the Runeborn magic passive Runeweaver (every 3 casts: shield the WHOLE squad 10% of the mage max HP): shield 0 alone took the magic squad 98% -> 72%; race human on the magic card 39%. CHOSEN: weapon stamina longbow 1.0 -> 1.4 (= greatsword; 1.5 starved the bow ~20% of its time), magic 1.0 -> 1.6; class skill stamina longbow 12/10/14/12 -> 16/14/19/16, magic 10/12/16/14 -> 14/16/22/19; magic skill damage arcane_orb 21 -> 18, repulse_nova 6.5 -> 5.5, starfall 14.5 -> 12.5 (~x0.85); Runeweaver max 3 -> 5 runes, shield 10% -> 2% (data/races/runeborn.json). Then wave_power_by_squad re-swept for the starter squad (90 seeds): 1.26 -> 66.7% (60), 1.28 -> 65.6%, 1.32 -> 55.6%; CHOSEN 1.30: 0.52/0.62/1.36/1.57/1.75/1.96 -> 0.5/0.59/1.3/1.5/1.67/1.87 (x0.956; solo/duo NOT measured). AFTER (final data, 120 seeds): starter squad 58.3% (HP at wave start w2-8 77.7%), magic squad 89.2% (86.8%), 3x sword_shield/greatsword/longbow/magic 0% each (as before: a mono squad cannot clear the level-15 finale). Stamina after: longbow in the starter squad short of its light attack 18% of alive time, 97 refused moves per run (it still attacks; no deadlock), magic 9% / skill-short 15%, sword_shield and greatsword under 3%. The magic squad stays ~89% (target was 70-75%): further trims measured 81-88% (Singularity zone 2 s, its shock off, its shield 0.1); a 70-75% magic squad needs a bigger Runeborn/magic rework: Boss decision. Placeholder until the Boss plays.
_tuning_guard_nerf: combat-designer 2026-11-20 (Boss: 'the player's HP never drops because the squad blocks too well and it is free: NERF the block'; then target win rate ~60%, band 55-65%, level 15 tier 1 starter squad). Global rules, so the goblin journey gets harder too (Boss accepted). MEASURED with tools/balance/class_sim.gd (new measurement-only guard table: enemy weapon/projectile hits on each card, share blocked, prevented damage = blocked damage x r/(1-r), guard breaks; overrides rule:<name>=x and react:<class>=x). BEFORE (reduction 0.7, stamina 11/power, reaction S&S 0.95 / others 0.85, squad power 1.38, 120 seeds): starter squad blocked 27% of 110 hits/run, prevented 288 dmg/run (18% of raw), 0.16 breaks/run, win 71.7%, HP at wave start w1..w9 100 96 93 86 86 74 71 62 58 (mean w2-8 81.3%); magic squad 100%. SWEEPS at squad power 1.38 (60 seeds, starter squad win / prevented per run / breaks): reduction 0.35 -> 56.7% / 137 / 0.17; 0.4 + stamina 20 -> 60.0% / 153 / 0.9; 0.45 + stamina 22 -> 56.7% / 175 / 1.1; 0.4 + stamina 30 -> 53.3% / 138 / 3.0 (breaks still rare: the squad has stamina); 0.45 + stamina 20 + reaction S&S 0.8 / others 0.65 -> 48.3% / 133, blocked share 27% -> 21%. Data alone (reduction) halves the prevented damage but barely moves the blocked share, so the pilot reaction went down too. CHOSEN: guard_damage_reduction 0.7 -> 0.45, guard_energy_per_power 11 -> 20 (a heavy hit like the knight bash 2.4 now costs 48 of 100 stamina), pilot reaction sword_shield 0.95 -> 0.8, greatsword/longbow/magic 0.85 -> 0.65 (the shield still blocks most); knockback factor unchanged. Then squad power re-swept for ~60% (starter squad): 1.25 -> 88.3% (60), 1.30 -> 68.3% (60), 1.32 -> 71.7% (120), 1.34 -> 63.3% (120), 1.36 -> 60.8% (120, CHOSEN), 1.38 -> 48.3% (60). wave_power_by_squad 0.53/0.63/1.38/1.59/1.78/1.99 -> 0.52/0.62/1.36/1.57/1.75/1.96 (all x0.986; solo/duo NOT measured), finale 0.65, heal 0.0 and monster stats unchanged. AFTER (final data, 120 seeds): starter squad 60.8%, blocked 21% of 102 hits/run, prevented 131 dmg/run (8.9% of raw, -55%), 0.61 breaks/run, HP at wave start 100 96 92 82 82 66 60 53 48 (mean w2-8 76.1%), lowest in wave 93 88 75 75 59 52 43 33 25; magic squad 99.2% (mean start 93.8%, not retuned: Boss says magic is too strong, a separate task). Goblin journey (level 1 starter gear, file untouched, 60 seeds): starter squad 88.3% -> 70.0%, prevented 458 -> 204 dmg/run, mean start w2-8 99.2% -> 98.6% (the 0.4 wave heal still refills HP there); magic squad 100% -> 98.3%. Placeholder until the Boss plays.
_tuning_wave_heal: combat-designer 2026-11-20 (Boss after playing the pyramid: 'the squad heals a lot between waves, HP is full all the time, the game is too easy'). MEASURED with tools/balance/class_sim.gd journey=mummy_waves level=15 gear=1 only=squad (new measurement-only HP rows: squad HP % = sum HP / sum max HP, a fallen card = 0, before the heal / at wave start / lowest in the wave; runs that reached the wave). BEFORE (heal 0.4, squad power 1.68, 60 seeds): starter squad 68.3%, HP at wave start w1..w9 = 100 100 100 99 100 95 95 91 89 (mean w2-8 97.1%; before the heal 91 92 89 90 73 77 68 66: the 40% heal refilled everything); magic squad 100%, starts 100 everywhere (mean 99.8%). SWEEPS (starter squad, level 15 tier 1, power = wave_power_by_squad[3]): heal 0.0 power 1.68 -> 13.3% (mean start w2-8 71.6%); heal 0.1 power 1.68 -> 46.7% (85.3%); heal 0.2 power 1.68 -> 60.0% (92.7%); heal 0.15 power 1.55 -> 90.0% (92.6%), 1.62 -> 73.3% (92.3%); heal 0.1 power 1.45 -> 86.7% (91.9%), 1.55 -> 78.3% (90.5%); heal 0.05 power 1.5 -> 71.7% (85.4%), 1.45 -> 78.3% (87.2%, 120 seeds); heal 0.0 power 1.3 -> 91.7% (83.8%), 1.35 -> 76.7% (82.4%, 120), 1.38 -> 73.9% (81.3%, 180), 1.4 -> 65.0% (60) / 67.2% (180), 1.42 -> 58.3% (120), 1.45 -> 70.0% / 65.0% (60 + 60, noise ~+-7% at 60 seeds). Any heal >= 0.1 keeps the mean start at 90%+ once the power is re-tuned to ~70% win (the heal still refills most of each wave), so only heal 0.0 reaches the 60-85% target. CHOSEN: wave_heal_fraction 0.4 -> 0.0, wave_power_by_squad 0.65/0.77/1.68/1.93/2.17/2.42 -> 0.53/0.63/1.38/1.59/1.78/1.99 (all x0.821 like the squad-of-3 entry; solo/duo NOT measured), finale power 0.65 and monster stats unchanged. AFTER (final data, no overrides): level 15 tier 1 starter 71.7% (120 seeds), HP at wave start w1..w9 = 100 96 93 86 86 74 71 62 58, lowest in wave 93 89 79 80 64 60 51 47 32, mean start w2-8 81.3%, runs starting w9 under 50% HP 40/112; magic squad 100%, starts 100 98 97 98 97 91 92 90 91 (mean 94.8%). Level 10 tier 1: starter 51.7% (mean 79.4%) / magic 98.3% (93.2%); level 5 tier 1: starter 60.0% (79.2%) / magic 95.0% (89.4%) (60 seeds each; level 5 vs 10 differ within noise). Damage taken per wave (level 15 starter) 49 55 119 75 206 157 217 202 300 vs 61 76 153 105 299 250 325 345 463 before: each wave hits a bit softer, but the damage now carries forward. Goblin journey NOT changed (Boss: do not rework goblins): measured heal 0.4 level 1 starter gear starter 88.3% start 100 everywhere (mean 99.6%), magic 100% (100%). Placeholder until the Boss plays.
_tuning_hard_hits_round2: ROUND 2, combat-designer 2026-11-19 (Boss/PO after round 1: HP back near the pre-change values, damage about 2x the ORIGINAL ATK, ~70% for the level-15 tier-1 starter squad; statuses, boss CTRL_RES 100 and the animator's grunt startup 18 / MOVESPD 12 kept). Base stats (HP / ATK, original -> round 1 -> round 2): grunt 45/15 -> 11/45 -> 36/30, archer 33/14 -> 8/46 -> 28/31 (28 measured first, raised to 31 to keep the family hit order above the grunt), mage 36/16.5 -> 9/50 -> 32/33, knight 165/18 -> 41/56 -> 140/36, Pharaoh 225/18.8 -> 100/72 -> 200/40, High Wizard 300/20 -> 135/77 -> 270/42 (ATK 2.0-2.1x, HP 0.8-0.9x the original). SWEEPS (level 15 tier 1 starter squad, finale 0.65 unless noted): squad power 1.0 -> 100% (30), 1.2 -> 100% (30), 1.4 -> 93% (30), 1.5 + finale 0.8 -> 83% (30), 1.6 -> 80% (30), 1.6 + finale 0.75 -> 83% (60), 1.68 -> 71.2%, CHOSEN (60), 1.75 -> 63% (30); bosses ATK x1.3 + finale 0.9: power 1.5 -> 47%, 1.4 -> 53%; with finale 0.8 -> 77% (30, not kept: more spike, same rate). wave_power_by_squad -> 0.65/0.77/1.68/1.93/2.17/2.42 (all x0.836 of the original 0.78/0.925/2.01/2.3/2.6/2.9; solo/duo NOT measured), finale power 0.65. RESULT (60 seeds; level 5/10 and tier 0 measured with the archer at ATK 28): level 15 tier 1 starter 71.2% (archer 28) / 68.3% (archer 31, FINAL data) / magic 100%; level 10 tier 1 starter 66.7% / magic 98.3%; level 5 tier 1 starter 65.0% / magic 95.0%; level 15 tier 0 starter 0% / magic 55% (the starter squad wipes at waves 3-7 on tier-0 gear). DAMAGE FELT vs the ORIGINAL build (both level 15 tier 1 starter, 60 seeds): per hit = ATK x2.0-2.1 x squad power 1.68/2.01 = about 1.7x; per second of fight 12.6 vs 8.4 (1.5x: 2014 taken over 159 s vs 2124 over 254 s); per wave 62 74 151 106 318 236 302 322 444 vs 31 63 138 110 270 206 263 263 780 (w1 2x, w2-w8 1.0-1.2x, the finale lower because the old finale was a long slog). At a fixed ~70% win rate the total damage a squad can take is capped by its HP and the 40% wave heal, so the total per wave cannot double; the hits are harder and the fights shorter. Goblin journey re-measured unchanged: 88.3% starter / 100% magic (level 1, starter gear). Placeholder until the Boss plays.
_tuning_hard_hits: ROUND 1 (superseded by _tuning_hard_hits_round2). combat-designer 2026-11-19 (Boss from his own play: 'the mummies hit far too softly', raise the family's damage ~2-3x as FELT, re-tune to ~70% win for the zone-level squad). REFERENCE = starter squad, card level 15, tier-1 gear (level=15 gear=1), 60 seeds, tools/balance/class_sim.gd journey=mummy_waves only=squad. BEFORE (old data): level 15 tier 1 starter 93% / magic 100%; level 15 tier 0 starter 12% / magic 95%; level 15 starter gear starter 0% / magic 78%. Per-hit damage to a level-15 tier-0 card before -> after: grunt strike 6 -> 15, grasp 16 -> 42, knight bash 36 -> 96, mage curse 28 -> 71, Pharaoh nova 42 -> 84, Wizard curse 41 -> 84, Wizard bolt 27 -> 54 (2.0-2.7x felt). SWEEPS (24-30 seeds unless noted, multipliers on the old base stats via class_sim stat:mummy:ATK=x / HP=x): ATK x2.5 with HP x1.0 0%, x0.7 0%, x0.5 12%, x0.35 29%, x0.25 71%; ATK x2.0 HP x0.5 12%, HP x0.35 66%; ATK x2.5 HP x0.5 with wave heal 0.7 17%, heal 1.0 17% (heal is not the lever); ATK x2.5 HP x0.3 squad power 2.01 37%, 1.85 75%, 1.7 71%, 1.55 83%; ATK x3 HP x0.25 power 1.7 70%, HP x0.3 62%; fewer monsters (count scale 1.0) HP x0.4 73%, x0.5 30% (kept 1.5: the Boss's wave look). Hitting 3x harder AND keeping the HP needs the squad to out-damage it, which it cannot: the HP had to come down (shorter, deadlier fights). CHOSEN base stats (combat.json): grunt HP 11 ATK 45, archer 8/46, mage 9/50, knight 41/56, Pharaoh 100/72, High Wizard 135/77 (bosses keep half their old HP, the rest a quarter); finale power 1.04 -> 0.65 (60 seeds, squad power 1.7: 0.75 -> 60%, 0.7 -> 60%, 0.65 -> 71%, CHOSEN). Then the animator's request (grunt mummy_strike startup 10 -> 18 so the 0.4 s clip wind-up reads; grunt MOVESPD 32 -> 12, a shamble; tests/test_monster_rig.gd passes) made the waves easier: squad power 1.7 -> 82% (60), re-swept: 1.85 -> 50% (30), 1.8 + finale 0.7 -> 53% (30), finale 0.75 -> 80% (30), 1.75 -> 69.5% (60), 1.78 -> 71.5% (60), 1.76 CHOSEN. wave_power_by_squad 0.78/0.925/2.01/2.3/2.6/2.9 -> 0.68/0.81/1.76/2.02/2.28/2.54 (all scaled x0.876 like the squad-of-3 entry; solo/duo NOT measured). AFTER (final data, 60 seeds): level 15 tier 1 starter 69% over 120 seeds (61.7% seeds 0-59, 76.7% seeds 60-119: about +-7% is seed noise) / magic 95%; level 10 tier 1 starter 53% / magic 82%; level 5 tier 1 starter 50% / magic 77%; level 15 tier 0 starter 0% / magic 23% (wiped at waves 3-7: tier-0 gear at level 15 is now a wall). Damage taken per wave at level 15 tier 1 (starter): 73 72 112 82 212 182 203 239 425. Statuses on the player (new, PLACEHOLDER chances; effective = chance + attacker ACC - card EFFECT_RES, a tier-1 card has ~19 EFFECT_RES, tier 0 ~11, starter gear 0): Wizard bolt weaken 15 (16% eff. vs tier 1) + bleed 10 (6%); curse circle curse 70 (71%) + exhaust 60 (61%); starfall burn 40 (36% per mark) + shock 20 (6%; 25% vs starter gear); sandstorm slow 60 (61%) + weaken 40 (41%); Pharaoh combo bleed 30 (26%); nova curse 70 (66%) + wound 50 (46%); knight bash stun 35 (16%) + sunder 60 (41%); mage curse circle curse 70 (61%) + exhaust 50 (41%); grunt grasp curse 50 (31%) + bleed 30 (11%). Bosses CTRL_RES 100 (Boss rule). Goblin journey untouched, re-measured. Placeholder until the Boss plays.
_tuning_boss_pair: combat-designer 2026-11-18, tools/balance/class_sim.gd journey=mummy_waves only=starter:squad. REFERENCE SQUAD for zone 2 = the starter squad at card level 5 with tier-1 gear (level=5 gear=1; PO default: a squad that has farmed the goblin zone; the goblin journey's reference is level 1 starter gear at ~82-88%). Before (Pharaoh alone, power 1.15, archer+mage escorts): 80% at level 5/tier 1. Pair + all escorts at 1.15: 0% (every run wiped at w9). Pair + 2 mummies + archer + mage: power 0.6 -> 88% (24 seeds), 0.66 -> 77% (48), 0.7 -> 63% (48), 0.8 -> 42% (24). Pair + 2 mummies only: 0.66 -> 78% (60, CHOSEN), 0.7 -> 73% (60), 0.74 -> 71% (48), 0.8 -> 67% (48). At 0.66: damage taken per wave 1..9 = 38 58 166 111 286 246 300 306 639 (the pair is the peak, 2x any plain wave); every loss is at w9. W9 damage by move (12 seeds at 0.7, per run): wizard curse ~280, starfall ~140, sandstorm ~15 (it fires ~1 per run), Pharaoh combo ~120 + nova ~40, mummies ~90: the High Wizard is the main threat. Other squads at 0.66: level 10/tier 1 starter squad 89%, magic squad 100%; level 1 starter gear: starter squad 0% (wiped at waves 4-7, BEFORE the boss: the mummy family is 1.5x the goblin, unchanged here) and magic squad 47%. Solo/duo not measured. Boss 2026-11-18 option a (ai.skills): the Wizard now bolts (light) and rolls starfall then curse each on its own cooldown (curse 240), so the curse no longer spams; at 0.66 that was 100%, so the finale power was re-swept: 0.85 -> 97%, 1.0 -> 86%, 1.03 -> 82% (60), 1.04 -> 82% (60, CHOSEN), 1.06 -> 72% (60), 1.1 -> 60%, 1.2 -> 40%. At 1.04: w9 taken 901 (3x any plain wave); level 15/tier 1 squad 93% (Boss: players reach the pyramid with level 15 cards); goblin_waves re-measured unchanged at 88% (starter, level 1). The earlier 78% at 0.66 was the 3-move kit. Placeholder until the Boss plays.
